review.overall_assessment: The diagram covers most core CTS transaction flows and support behaviors, but it still omits two requirements about terminal-user operation constraints and shows several exceptional-path actions that terminate without a modeled continuation or join, creating unresolved control-flow semantics on multiple branches.

defects.description: Action N16 is a dead end on the buy exception path; the diagram does not show any continuation or termination after reporting no matched stock.
defects.evidence: R28 requires the buy transaction to report when no matched stock exists. The diagram routes E17 from N11 to N16, but N16 has no outgoing edge.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N16 to an appropriate continuation or final node, or add the missing post-exception handling if the flow is intended to continue.

defects.description: Action N23 is a dead end on the sell suspension path; the diagram does not show any continuation or termination after handling suspended operations.

defects.suggested_action: Connect N23 to the intended end state or follow-up handling so the exceptional branch is semantically complete.
